records.title: Sharp exponential expected local-optimum count
records.statement: For fixed iid Uniform[0,1] complete-graph edge costs, tours modulo rotation/reversal, lim (E[M_n]/sqrt(n!))^(1/n) = rho = exp(-1/2) min_{a>=0} exp(a^2/2) integral_0^infinity exp(-y^2/2-a*y)dy, approximately 0.597586978551345. An exact rational certificate gives rho<3/5 and E[M_n]=O((3/5)^n sqrt(n!)).
records.remaining: Q3818 was already proved locally; no new catalog closure. This is a matching exponential rate, not asymptotic equivalence, a bounded correction at rho, count concentration or a runtime result. Wider literature priority is not established.

records.title: Expected-count rate at a regular lower endpoint
records.statement: The same exponential rate holds for a fixed iid absolutely continuous edge-cost law supported above a finite lower endpoint, with finite positive limiting density there; no upper-tail moment assumption is required.
records.remaining: Dependent shortest-path and Euclidean distances, endpoint atoms, zero/infinite endpoint density and size-dependent laws are outside the theorem. No novelty claim.

records.title: Submitted bounded replication of the handoff
records.statement: The return reports matching reruns of four finite predecessor checkers after verifying all 614 handoff payloads: count, forced-edge elimination, residual compression and gain pieces.
records.remaining: This is submitted replication evidence, not a new P1/P2/P3 theorem or an all-size audit of the full handoff. New intake reruns cover the sharp-rate checks.
